studio.title: About the studio
studio.lead: Octa Technology is an independent team that comes up with, illustrates and builds its own apps. We take every product from idea to release on Google Play and the App Store, and keep supporting it after launch.
studio.p1d: Design, illustration and development in the same hands, so every app feels whole.
studio.p2d: We collect only the data an app cannot work without, and say so plainly in our policies.
studio.p3d: Every app ships on both platforms, for phones and tablets.
